productStoryReviewHtml:
First, check if the experience was positive — and only then suggest leaving a review.

Ideal for tourism businesses, clinics, schools, and any service that wants to build loyalty and improve its online reputation.

  • After each service or session, your staff sends a short satisfaction survey
  • If the feedback is positive, they suggest sharing the experience on Google
  • If it's not, you're notified privately so you can respond directly and resolve the issue
productStoryLeadHtml:
Reply instantly to every inquiry and ask the key questions — so you only speak with people who are actually worth your time.

Like having a sales rep available 24/7 who handles every inquiry and passes you only the right prospects.

  • Someone shows interest — your staff responds immediately and asks qualification questions. No one goes unanswered
  • Qualified leads are sent to you instantly with all the details — you join the conversation fully prepared
  • Unqualified leads are saved in a list you can review anytime — no contact is lost
  • At the end of the day, you get a summary: how many leads were handled, how many qualified, and how many didn't
productStoryFollowHtml:
Reconnect with people who stopped responding — without needing to remember or losing track of any contact.

You choose the channel and how persistent to be. The system handles the rest automatically.

  • Upload your Excel file with contacts and pending proposals — follow-ups start automatically
  • Messages are sent through your chosen channel — WhatsApp, email, or both — as many times as you decide
  • When someone replies, you're notified instantly so you can jump back into the conversation

faqSub: Everything you need to know about Equipo Experto.
faqQ1: Do I need to know how to code or build workflows?
faqA1: Not at all. There is zero coding, and you don't need to connect complicated "nodes" and logic paths like Zapier or Make.com. You simply enter basic text details (like an email or response message), and click the ON toggle. The system handles all the logic behind the scenes.
faqQ2: How long does it take to set up?
faqA2: Less than 2 minutes. We've pre-built the most effective automation "recipes" specifically designed for local and service-based small businesses. You just choose what you want to automate, fill out a few fields, and you're good to go.
faqQ3: What happens if a customer leaves a bad review?
faqA3: Our Restaurant Review Funnel recipe intelligently asks for internal feedback first. If they rate their experience highly, it redirects them to Google to leave a public review. If they had a negative experience, it captures their feedback privately and emails you directly, allowing you to resolve the problem while protecting your online reputation.
faqQ4: Do you offer customer support if I get stuck?
faqA4: Absolutely. While the platform is designed to be self-serve and simple, we know questions can come up. Every plan includes direct support to ensure you get your automations active and working properly.
faqQ5: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faqA5: Yes, there are no long-term contracts or setup fees. You can cancel your subscription at any time with a single click inside your dashboard.
